tools.description: Read a messages.jsonl transcript: your own by default, or the one path names. Two modes. Without step it lists one short line per step (turn.step, e.g. 3.2), newest step first: messages cut to a preview, tool calls with their arguments cut, ok or error and the result size; results and reasoning are not listed. With step it returns that step whole, paged by cursor.

context.description: With search: how many steps to list on each side of a match. Default 0.

cursor.description: Continue where the previous response stopped; use the cursor it gave. Not with turns, step or part.

part.description: With step: both (default) is a tool call and its result and the text of a message; call is the call and messages only, result the results only, reasoning the reasoning steps only (they are never listed).

path.description: Which transcript to read; omit it for your own (a sub-agent reads its own run). profile:<category>/<name> is another profile in this session and profile:<session>/<category>/<name> one in another session; subagent:<run id> (sub_xxxxxxxx) is a run of your profile, subagent:<category>/<name>/<run id> or subagent:<session>/<category>/<name>/<run id> a run of another profile; path:<file> is a file (only when tools.native.transcript.allow_path is true). remote:<name>/ before a profile: or subagent: path that names its session reads another JAD server (only when allow_remote is on; no file paths come back). The header of a read and a not-found error give the exact path to reuse.

role.description: List mode: only steps of this role; tool is a tool call (with its result).

search.description: List mode: only steps whose whole text (a call's arguments and result too) contains this, case-insensitive; the line shows only the preview.

source.description: messages (default) is the live transcript; backup is messages.backup.jsonl, the history before the last compaction.

step.description: Detail mode: read one step whole, 3.2 (turn 3, step 2), or a range 3.1-3.4, which comes back in transcript order, starting at its oldest step. Step numbers come from the list, which starts at the newest step. Not with turns, role, tool, search or context.

tool.description: List mode: only calls of tools whose name matches; * and ? are wildcards (read, exec*).

turns.description: List mode: which turns to list: 3, 3-7, -5 (the last five) or 12- (from turn 12). A turn is a user message and the answer to it. Default: every turn, a page at a time.

tools.name: transcript
